verdict.rationale: Mastra Knowledge is a graph-structured knowledge and memory product, so temporal fact validity is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only shows that editing a page gives agents the new version and that Knowledge 'keeps itself current.' That is overwrite-style updating, not tracking when facts became valid or invalid. Nothing documents validity timestamps, invalidation, or telling current facts apart from outdated ones.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can track when facts became valid or invalid (temporal reasoning) so the memory distinguishes current from outdated information
